source_order: Full local legal-structure reading of 86 corpus articles preceded legal tasks and query wording. Historical inputs were read only for rejection screening, never system outputs.

cross_document_corrections.A03: Do not count D4: L6/L10/L11/L13/L14 can plausibly provide a full single-Law alternative. Kept as multi-article only; reviewer B should examine alternatives.

cluster_rationales.research_integrity: A01/A13/D01 share AI research/publication integrity; variation adds closed-lab, data-access or copyright boundary needs. Entire cluster DEV, including reserve, prevents reuse across TEST.
cluster_rationales.foreign_contact: A02/C15 share foreign high-risk supplier contact versus mandatory-certification representation; same material legal branch. Entire cluster DEV family; reserve cannot migrate to TEST.
cluster_rationales.significant_integration: A08/B06 share significant integration and changed-risk workflow; one focuses supplier release and one deployer reclassification. Conservative same TEST cluster.
cluster_rationales.third_party_brand_provider: B09/C06 share own-brand provider identity despite outsourced model development. Entire cluster TEST.
cluster_rationales.voluntary_support_information: B04/C14 share optional electronic information/template in voluntary-sharing support. Entire cluster DEV family.
cluster_rationales.art_publication_transparency: A06/B10 share AI artwork made public and adapted label placement. Distinct ethical versus handoff obligations, but common scenario-template exposure is conservatively clustered in TEST.

semantic_review.A01: Not eval011/014 or dev005/006: negative closed-lab scope joined to research integrity, not sandbox benefits/ordinary admission requirements.
semantic_review.A02: Not eval004/005a: finite foreign-supplier handoff and representation distinction, rather than general high-risk management checklist.
semantic_review.A03: Potential thematic overlap eval003/009/004. Admission explicitly justified for first-pass review: education-specific learner protections, known certification branch and first-release workflow change both bounded ask and proposition bundle; not a cosmetic scenario substitution. Flag B review.
semantic_review.A04: Infrastructure owner's voluntary sharing, technology choice and energy constraints are distinct from historical data-connection questions eval019/023.
semantic_review.A05: Potential overlap eval025/026/027: concrete benefit-ranking governance combines authorization timing, publication exclusions, three bias sources and final human responsibility. Substantial new scoped bundle; admit provisionally with B review rather than claim unseen historical topic.
semantic_review.A06: Potential overlap eval007/008/027: voluntary cultural/complaint governance of an exhibit differs from a generic labeling or ethics list. Public-art label content clustered with B10.
semantic_review.A07: Not eval006/007: special free-system technical-marking alternative and actor handoff, not general supplier transparency. Distinct machine marking versus human label scope.
semantic_review.A08: Not eval004/005a: post-assessment significant model/data change, third-party information agreement and re-release records. Clustered with B06.
semantic_review.A09: Lifecycle energy/social-benefit choice and national-grid constraint are distinct from general ethics definitions eval027.
semantic_review.A10: Accessible public-service interface, truthful capability and fallback/feedback is a finite accessibility task; not same as generic human control eval030 or rights-impact control eval029.
semantic_review.A11: Legacy timing plus unavailable portal and circular effectivity is a new temporal/operational legal task, not historical first-release timing eval003.
semantic_review.A12: No-fault high-risk compensation allocation and exceptions plus preventive risk notification differs from incident repair eval010/dev003; financial quantification D09 is a separate task.
semantic_review.A13: Same publication integrity template as A01/D01; intentionally same DEV family reserve. Different from general data-connection eval023.
semantic_review.A14: Voluntary open research combined with noncash support/property retention differs from generic ethics eval027 and data categories eval021.
semantic_review.A15: Exclusive defence statutory scope not represented in historical or existing DEV inputs; same-Article C04 changes a material scope predicate and is kept DEV family conservatively.
semantic_review.B01: Potential overlap eval012/014/dev006: reduced SME level-1 dossier, specific valid-file timeline and technical support differs from ordinary dossier or authority enumeration. Admit provisionally with explicit B review.
semantic_review.B02: Voucher direct settlement and 50% sandbox cost cap are not historical sandbox procedural questions.
semantic_review.B03: Not eval025/026: supplemental assessment on input change plus operator training, not initial assessment trigger/report contents.
semantic_review.B04: Optional information/template and no recurring reporting in sharing support are different from sandbox periodic reporting eval016.
semantic_review.B05: Partially recognized foreign assessment, remaining content and publication/technical retention differs from broad high-risk management eval004/005a.
semantic_review.B06: Post-integration risk increase, 15-working-day notice and immediate controls are a specific reclassification timing task, not initial dossier eval003. Same TEST cluster as A08.
semantic_review.B07: Potential overlap eval010/dev003: narrow nonurgent asset incident, confirmation versus investigation, non-admission effect and two reporting clocks; substantially different from generic supplier incident obligations. Admit provisionally with B review.
semantic_review.B08: Safe training environment, manager/user separation and reidentification control differ from generic dataset connection eval023 and government creation/updating eval022.
semantic_review.B09: Third-party model information access, international technical documentation and cooperation agreement differ from broad management/transparency eval004/006; same TEST cluster as C06.
semantic_review.B10: Producer/distributor information handoff and adapted film labels differ from generic eval007/008; conservative same TEST cluster as A06.
semantic_review.B11: Cluster recognition and independent legal identities are absent historical tasks; training support is not a cosmetic sandbox admission question.
semantic_review.B12: Specific legal automated notice acknowledgment and no extra documents is distinct from eval003 initial dossier timing; D04 asks an absent technical API specification, a different material request.
semantic_review.B13: State data publication and access/property retention overlap data operator task B08 sufficiently for conservative same TEST-family reserve cluster; not merely data category questions.
semantic_review.B14: Post-completion transitional operation extension differs from eval017 extension of trial itself and eval018 initial processing of trial completion. Needs B structural screening before reserve activation.
semantic_review.B15: University duties of workforce cooperation/sharing, not generic AI ethical control or technical developer management.
semantic_review.C01: Personal noncommercial use versus deployer role not equivalent to broad developer obligation dev007.
semantic_review.C02: Office exception with excluded high-risk membership is a specific negative branch, not risk-level enumeration eval001.
semantic_review.C03: Private nonpublic-service circular applicability differs from asking principles of ethics eval027; no generic ethics list required.
semantic_review.C04: Dual-use defeats exclusive defence exemption; not historical topic. Keep exclusive-defence reserve A15 within DEV family to avoid predicate-variant leakage.
semantic_review.C05: Standalone model versus system classification scope, not enumeration of risk levels eval001.
semantic_review.C06: Own-brand provider versus outsourced developer, not general management duties. Same TEST cluster as B09.
semantic_review.C07: Potential overlap eval002: that asks who issues the list (Prime Minister); this asks who consolidates proposals and whether that task belongs to developers (Ministry). Different actor/proposition and decision, explicitly admitted pending B review.
semantic_review.C08: Routine-update exceptions for two distinct repeat procedures, not baseline management checklists.
semantic_review.C09: Insurance encouragement versus conditional sandbox financial security is a new cross-regime scope distinction.
semantic_review.C10: Public-service developer applicability to data/model poisoning security differs from human-oversight eval029/030 and generic ethics list eval027.
semantic_review.C11: Potential overlap eval013: concrete level-1 versus level-2 determination turns on operational use of outputs, not generic factors or a noun substitution. Explicitly admitted pending B review.
semantic_review.C12: State-secret portal exclusion without security-law exemption is distinct from baseline public data architecture questions.
semantic_review.C13: EXCLUDE after conservative A structural QA: historical eval010 asks supplier incident obligations, while this developer-only variant still uses the same joint developer/supplier obligation bundle L12.2.a. Actor distinction does not sufficiently separate the underlying task; preserve record and exclusion reason rather than retain as reserve.
semantic_review.C14: Near duplicate of B04 template identified; same DEV-family reserve cluster rather than separate independent item or TEST candidate.
semantic_review.C15: Same foreign contact/representation branch as A02 with unknown certification condition. Same DEV-family reserve, prohibited migration to TEST.
semantic_review.D01: Copyright allocation absence plus research integrity not in historical list; same DEV cluster as research-integrity candidates.
semantic_review.D02: Core hardware policy eligibility and missing tax rate are a tax-specific boundary task, not historical legal task.
semantic_review.D03: Only administrative fine amount for label deletion; not generic labeling duties eval007/008 or A07. Contextual prohibition cannot answer numeric request.
semantic_review.D04: Only API endpoint/schema, absent from corpus; not notice process B12 or historical timing eval003. Distinct technical artifact task.
semantic_review.D05: Procurement preference/evaluation price rate is different from corporate tax rate D02: different legal decision, conditions and unavailable rule. Shared percentage wording alone is not a task template; B must check structural distinction.
semantic_review.D06: Technical-log post-shutdown retention period and inspection disclosure differ from generic high-risk management eval004/005a; not same ask as B05 foreign recognition.
semantic_review.D07: Access constraints plus fee tariff is not general data categories/connection eval019/021/023. Data operator B08 answers different actor and security task.
semantic_review.D08: Self-assessment and missing numerical data-quality pass threshold are not baseline management checklist; no arbitrary metric invented.
semantic_review.D09: Only asset valuation formula/cap, not liability allocation/exception A12 or incident repair dev003. No identical substantive proposition bundle despite same source Article.
semantic_review.D10: Current named assessor registry is an absent factual register; not assessment conditions or authority question.
semantic_review.D11: Missing core/important-data catalogue entries differ from definition of conditional open data eval020 or AI database categories eval021.
semantic_review.D12: Specialized outbound-personal-data transfer procedure absent; differs from domestic data connection/access eval023.
semantic_review.D13: Fiscal allocation for training absent, separate from tax/fee tasks by legal instrument and request; reserve only.
semantic_review.D14: Criminal article/penalty lookup absent, distinct from administrative label fine D03; reserve only, requires independent corpus review.
semantic_review.D15: Not admitted because unresolved internal cross-reference; never repaired by guessing intended law. Corpus-error concern, not system difficulty.

first_review_QA_changes.change: Removed D4 proposal because a full single-Law alternative is plausible; did not inflate cross-document counts. Restricted first-use support to a point with its necessary parent lead, not every alternative change trigger.
Selected the actual documentation-based free-system marking alternative, without requiring both mutually alternative compliance methods.
Made national-network participation explicit in the query before packaging instead of inventing that scenario fact only in gold.
Removed an unnecessary storage duty and D4 claim from the accessibility/feedback task to keep scope finite and user-grounded.
Removed an inapplicable label on a cash-conversion prohibition that actually applies; exclusion of a proposed right is not non-applicability of the prohibiting rule.
Specified direct use in administrative decisions in the question rather than silently assuming the material assessment predicate.
Kept technical control unknown and the contractor's developer status conditional. Own-brand provider status remains supported without guessing contractor facts.
Changed provisional reserve proposal to EXCLUDE for conservative historical task/proposition near-duplication; record and gold draft retained.
Moved reserve ancestry to the same DEV cluster as the foreign-contact task; no DEV-to-TEST reserve migration.
Changed answerability treatment to wholly insufficient for the requested start date; a nearby maximum duration is contextual and not substantive credit. Source-ambiguity exclusion retained.
Counted D9 positive examples using actual supported duties/statuses rather than treating all exclusion conclusions as positive applicability. Preserved existing exposure events on rebuilds.

known_corpus_flags.issue: Refers to results in paragraph 4 although reuse of existing results is addressed in paragraph 6; not silently corrected.
Change-function reference and catalogue-decision transition clock do not align; D15 excluded.
Sandbox compliance relief points to Law Article 22 (Fund); not used as sole support for relief.
Self-reference to paragraph 3 as a time point; not used for operative timing.
Law definition includes risk of significant harm while Decree list says actual consequences; do not force an unqualified danger-only deadline annotation.
Forms/appendices are referenced but not present as records in frozen corpus. Do not invent full official forms.
